gap: Qualify the public episode-fitted model on Crazyflow arm geometries not used in model development.

measurement.source: Run the pinned pass6 behavior controller and Crazyflow 0.3.2 plant at 100 Hz. The candidate never controls the source flights and receives only motion, issued commands and timestamps.
measurement.primary: Physical 250 ms body-rate and world-velocity RMSE on causal conditional forecasts, with native one-step errors and each origin retained.
measurement.reference: Hold measured world velocity and body rate from each forecast origin. This is a no-fit sanity reference, not a model-based incumbent.
measurement.runtime: Record initialization, first forecast, first update and warm update times separately; startup history and fitting time count.
measurement.failure: Retain every requested flight, floor contact, truncated run, insufficient 125-row prefix, nonfinite prediction and source mismatch. Missing forecasts are not scored as success.
measurement.scope: New arm lengths within one Crazyflow quad family. Recorded issued future commands make this a model test, not a live controller trial or unseen vehicle-class result. Counterfactual response truth is not available in these tapes.
